findings.title: var.subnets accepts subnets outside var.region and more than 10 entries, both of which the API rejects at apply
findings.explanation: Managed Kafka requires every network_configs subnet to be in the cluster's region and allows at most 10. The validation only checks the path shape, so a subnet from another region (an easy slip since var.region and the subnet are passed separately) or an 11th subnet plans cleanly and fails creating the cluster. Best-fit principle: apply-time correctness.
findings.remediation: Cap var.subnets at 10 and validate that each subnet's regions/<r>/ segment equals var.region (the module already relies on Terraform 1.9 cross-variable validation for kms_key_name).

findings.title: var.acls validation rejects the documented prefixed ACL IDs (topicPrefixed/, consumerGroupPrefixed/, transactionalIdPrefixed/)
findings.explanation: google_managed_kafka_acl supports PREFIXED resource patterns via acl_id values like topicPrefixed/orders-, but the key regex only allows the literal forms. Callers who need prefix ACLs (the usual way to scope a producer to a topic family) are forced to fall back to allTopics, which is broader than intended.
findings.remediation: Allow an optional Prefixed suffix on the topic/consumerGroup/transactionalId ACL ID forms.

suggested_policies.rationale: No built-in policy covers google_managed_kafka_topic. A replication factor below 3 is a single attribute check that applies to any Terraform creating Managed Kafka topics, and this module already enforces it through input validation.
suggested_policies.yaml:
id: LOCAL_GCP_001
name: Managed Kafka topics must use a replication factor of at least 3
principle: reliability
severity: MEDIUM
rationale: |
  Managed Service for Apache Kafka spreads partition replicas across zones. A topic
  with a replication factor below 3 loses availability, or data that was only on the
  failed broker, when a broker or zone fails.
message: |
  google_managed_kafka_topic has replication_factor below 3.
remediation: |
  Set replication_factor = 3 (or higher) on the topic.
resources:
  google_managed_kafka_topic:
    path: replication_factor
    gte: 3
